data.one_liner: Widget to switch and persist ThemeMode at runtime.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ThemeModeHandler widget that loads, saves and applies a ThemeMode using a user‑provided manager. It can show a placeholder while loading and offers a helper dialog for selection.
use_when: You need runtime theme switching with persistence
You want a simple API without external state‑management solutions
avoid_when: You already use a full state‑management library (e.g., Bloc, Provider) for theming
You need advanced theming features like color scheme generation
strengths: Supports null‑safety and custom placeholder widget
weaknesses: Only handles ThemeMode, not full theming customization
Requires you to implement IThemeModeManager for persistence

alternatives.name: flex_seed_scheme
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive theming and color scheme generation, useful if you need more than just ThemeMode switching
